key_points: ETFs sold $69.4M of JNJ on Oct 5, indicating some short-term selling pressure.
Long-term ICOTYDE psoriasis data released, improving the investment story for JNJ's immunology franchise.
After-hours stock advanced on news of a $5.5B proposal to resolve talc litigation, reducing legal overhang.
MedTech business expected to rebound in Q3 after a Q2 slowdown, supporting diversified earnings growth.
Earnings growth expectations remain intact despite patent cliff concerns, as JNJ advances its replacement engine.
